name: CG Animated Feature: Location Exterior
description: Image preset for a location exterior in the CG Animated Feature look.
system_prompt: Write one image prompt for an exterior establishing shot. Name the location's defining structure, surroundings, time of day, and weather from the entity, then apply the style.
context_prompt: wide exterior establishing view of the location, clear foreground, midground and background, a sense of scale from a figure or doorway, stylized 3D animated feature film still, appealing simplified proportions, large expressive eyes, sculpted hair shapes, soft subsurface skin, tactile cloth and fur, cinematic three-point lighting, warm key and cool fill, soft global illumination, shallow depth of field
negative_prompt: photorealistic human, uncanny, flat 2d, low-poly, harsh shadows, extra fingers, text, watermark
